subject: Re: Trainer Opportunity - Eisbär Strength & Fitness
lead_body:
Howdy Allen,

Thanks again for reaching out last week. I’m glad we had a chance to
connect at the gym and talk through your move to New Braunfels and what
you’re looking for.

When I took over the gym last June, one of my goals was to allow a small
number of independent trainers to operate out of the space. I know
firsthand that being fully independent means finding the right environment
to run your own business, and I think Eisbär Strength can provide that if
it’s the right fit.

Based on what you shared about your Dallas setup, this will be a bit
different, but in a good way once you get established here.

Here’s the model I'm building out:

   -

   You operate as an independent trainer and run your own business
   -

   No employment or contractor relationship with the gym
   -

   No revenue split, just a flat monthly rate

Monthly rate is based on overall usage:

   -

   $500: light usage
   -

   $750: moderate usage
   -

   $1,000: high us
